derivation_note: DERIVED: depends on globalMap (running valid/invalid counters, batchRunId read-back), context.max_retries, and the Talend built-in routine Numeric.sequence(name, start, step) whose counter state is process-global and not reproducible by a standalone harness without reimplementing Talend's routine runtime. Reasoned through assuming a fresh sequence 'job07ValidationSeq' starting at 1, step 1, and context.max_retries=3 (Dev context).

expected_output._note: amount>0 -> valid; validRowCount becomes 1; Numeric.sequence 1st call returns 1
amount<=0 -> invalidRowCount becomes 1, globalMap job07_invalidRowCount=1, System.err warn logged

cases.description: edge case: null amount -> invalid (NPE-safe check)

expected_output._note: input_row.amount==null short-circuits the '&& ...doubleValue()>0' check via Java's && before dereferencing -> ok=false, invalidRowCount becomes 2

cases.description: valid row in a second batch id

expected_output._note: validRowCount becomes 2 (counts are per-run, not per customer_batch_id)

cases.description: sequence counter keeps advancing across both valid and invalid rows

expected_output._note: Numeric.sequence is called unconditionally before the validity check, so invalid rows still consume a sequence number
